title: Design System: The Last Acquisition — Print

extensions.scope: Printable PDFs and character PNGs; homepage system remains in docs/DESIGN.md.

body.purpose: Printed reading text; manuals use 18 pt leading.

introduction.purpose: Largest measured size fitting one page; 2× PNG export.

footer.purpose: Footer and brief handling text; not the narrative floor.

components.name: Evidence Card
components.description: A neutral A/B cuttable print card; preview falls back to serif when the private build font is absent.
components.html:
Guest name / Card A

EVIDENCE UPDATE

Evidence is read privately at the gala.

Submit face down only when your packet tells you to.

narrative.overview: Flat white-stock documents use Libron book typography, Meridian blue identity fields, and practical spacing for reading, handwriting, cutting, and sealing. The gala belongs to 2026; costumes are optional.

rules.name: Narrative floor
rules.body: Preserve 14 pt narrative text; introductory prose measures between 16 and 20 pt.

rules.name: Neutral evidence labels
rules.body: A/B labels vary by branch assignment and never function as a guilt legend.

dos: Preserve canonical game logic and both private branches.
Print single-sided at 100% and cut dashed borders.
Embed PDF fonts without shipping standalone font binaries.
donts: Do not replace the independent homepage system.
Do not send private packets as pre-party introductions.
Do not shrink narrative text to conceal overflow.
